gen-gf-underdog-archivo: Underdog draws every curve at a single thickness, its c flung open like a horseshoe. And Archivo, with outward-opening curves and a tall x-height, keeps paragraphs feeling editorial and approachable throughout.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-asap: Asap reads openly, its c forms curving as open arcs and its lowercase rising almost to the height of the capitals. Underdog adds the memorable part: horseshoe-wide curves with no weight shift.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-merriweather-sans: Underdog keeps its bowls full, never thinning at the sides. That gives the top line a loud, expressive punch, while Merriweather Sans does the quieter work with tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-gf-underdog-general-sans: General Sans holds a steady pressure and fills the line with its x-height. Underdog is the one to make a loud entrance, with horseshoe-open curves, while General Sans does the patient work of carrying the words.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-amiko: Wide-eyed and uniform, Unica One keeps its lines in strict, measured step. Amiko, whose lowercase stands tall and whose terminals point outward like tongs, adds a modern, neutral voice underneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Big-eyed and blunt, Unica One draws a ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono stretches its spacing wide and keeps counters open, so text feels approachable, with room to breathe.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-biryani: Commanding, that is Unica One: huge-eyed lowercase with daylight in every curve. Biryani does the quieter job, with a clear, large eye on every e and counters that never clog, keeping text approachable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-blinker: Unica One has a very large lowercase eye and daylight in every curve. Blinker holds its line thickness with open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height, an approachable quality that anchors the pair.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carrois-gothic: Stitched-thread lines, huge eyes: that is Unica One at a glance. Carrois Gothic follows with a high-set x-height and a generous c opening, turning the loud top line into steady reading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Unica One frames every counter in strokes of identical width. That makes it the loud one, while Carrois Gothic SC does the quiet work, with open curve endings and capitals nearly level with lowercase.
